scripts.dev: npm run build:lib && tsx scripts/demo.ts dev
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && tsx scripts/demo.ts build
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:lib && npm run build --workspace @viktar-b/cso-cli
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:lib && tsx scripts/demo.ts build
scripts.build:lib: npm run build --workspace @viktar-b/cso-core && npm run build --workspace @viktar-b/cso-react
scripts.test: npm run test:projects && npm run test:python && npm run test:integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:lib && tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces && biome lint tests scripts/check-library-archives.ts scripts/check-project-isolation.ts scripts/run-python-tests.ts
scripts.test:projects: npm run build:cli && npm run test --workspaces
